scripts.lint: bun run frontend:lint && bun run backend:lint
scripts.lint:check: bun run frontend:lint:check && bun run backend:lint:check
scripts.format: bun run frontend:format && bun run backend:format
scripts.format:check: bun run frontend:format:check && bun run backend:format:check
scripts.test: bun run frontend:test && bun run backend:test
scripts.type-check: bun run frontend:type-check && bun run backend:type-check
scripts.ci: bun run lint:check && bun run format:check && bun run type-check && bun run test
scripts.pre-commit: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check
scripts.pre-commit:fix: bun run format && bun run lint
